MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The SanDisk 32GB microSD card with an adapter fits my repeated purchases of similar storage and gives me a useful spare for compatible equipment.",
    "The Fire HD 10 caught my interest because its larger screen and extra storage offer a clear difference from my Fire 7, although I would not replace my tablet right now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo devices assume I want voice assistance or video calling, but my purchases show practical equipment needs rather than a current reason to add those functions.",
    "The streaming sticks relate to my TV, but owning a TV and recently buying a DVD player does not mean I currently want streaming equipment; 4K adds little for my recorded 720p set.",
    "The older Fire 7 duplicates a tablet I already own, while the earbuds and wall mount address needs I have not expressed."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been treated as interest in many Amazon devices, even when they serve unrelated purposes.",
    "Owning electronics seems to have been taken as a reason to suggest more devices, when I often buy accessories to keep existing equipment useful."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of memory cards, adapters, readers, and storage cases make compatible storage accessories especially relevant.",
    "My recent lens cap and history of tripods point toward maintaining and supporting camera equipment.",
    "A useful accessory or spare can meet an ongoing need, while replacing a working tablet or adding TV equipment requires a specific benefit and a current reason."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in electronics but missed how strongly my current choices favor practical, compatible accessories for equipment I already own."
}
